commitResults.messageTitle: Bump app version to v1.6
Keep Planned Enhancements within the 10-item limit
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG listed 11 planned enhancements, above the course limit of
2 x team size (10). Drop the pasted-tab item, the least likely of
the flaws to be met in normal use.

commitResults.messageTitle: Stop at startup when the data folder cannot be opened
commitResults.messageBody:
If the data folder cannot be opened, or addressbook.json is a link to
a missing file, the file was treated as absent. The app then loaded
the sample contacts, and the first successful save replaced the real
contacts with them, with no backup.

Treat a file that is not confirmed absent as unreadable. The existing
backup step then fails safely, so startup stops and the data file is
left unchanged, as the UG describes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject notes made only of invisible format characters
commitResults.messageBody:
A note made only of a character such as U+2060 (word joiner), U+FEFF,
U+200C or U+200D was accepted, through note and from the data file.
history then showed a timestamp with nothing after it, although the
UG says a note cannot be blank.

Treat every Unicode format character as invisible, as U+200B already
was. Such characters are still allowed next to visible text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix DG and UG statements found in beta testing
commitResults.messageBody:
- DG: history and deletenote order notes by stored list position, not
  by timestamp; remove the paragraph about an unimplemented undo.
- Find sequence diagram: show both find alice and find p/9123 and give
  the two predicates different names.
- UI class diagram: MainWindow always has one HelpWindow.
- Alternative model diagram: add Status, FollowUp, LastContact and
  InteractionNote to Person.
- UG: say Page Up/Page Down scroll one line, note that a few rare
  characters count as 2 towards the name limit, use a list example
  that matches the sample data, and sort the command summary.
- Testing guide: correct the StringUtilTest package.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep contact details out of the log file
commitResults.messageBody:
The INFO log recorded every command in full, every result (an edit
result is the whole contact), every failed command, and, for an
unreadable data file, Jackson's message, which can quote the file.
Names, phone numbers, addresses and notes stayed in
easyinsurance.log.0 next to the JAR after delete or clear.

Log only the command word, whether the command succeeded, and the
type of a data file error.

Also stop FileUtil.writeToFile from writing through a symbolic link,
so a link planted at preferences.json cannot make the app overwrite
another file at startup.

commitResults.messageTitle: Split the logged command word on Unicode spaces too
commitResults.messageBody:
The parser accepts non-breaking and other Unicode spaces between the
command word and its arguments, so the log must split on the same
characters or it would still record names typed after them.

commitResults.messageTitle: Log the command type instead of the first word typed
commitResults.messageBody:
Logging the first word still recorded personal data when that word
was not a command, such as a pasted NRIC or phone number. Log the
parsed command's type instead, so unrecognised input is never logged.

Also stop logging the invalid value from a data file that fails
validation, and stop attaching the original exception to the fatal
startup error, whose stack trace could print the data file's contents.
